question: Does the trained transformer-memory trunk contain VDA4 information that fresh actor and critic heads can exploit without any further trunk learning?

training.probe_note: Neutral actor bias and stronger entropy deliberately prevent the always-wait collapse; success tests representation accessibility, not exact replication of the failed behavior policy.

success_interpretation.above_chance: Frozen H2 contains task-relevant information accessible to fresh nonlinear heads.
success_interpretation.chance_with_noncollapsed_actor: The trained trunk does not expose sufficient VDA4 information to the heads.
success_interpretation.actor_collapse: Probe is inconclusive and requires an explicit behavior-policy exploration floor.
